During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], between [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''battle''' occurred in the [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni system]] when an [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]] attempted to destroy a neutral [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. The Republic, however, sent a [[Republic Navy/Legends|fleet]] together with the famous [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron to repel the Imperials. While the Republic's [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]] attacked the Imperial capital ships, Coruscant Aegis destroyed the Imperial [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Mark VI ''Supremacy''-class starfighters]], preventing them from bombing the station. Afterwards Aegis squadron attacked the capital ships and the Imperial fleet, now overwhelmed and suffering heavy damage, retreated to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
